sources.title: Spirit FY2024 Form 10-K — concentration and liquidity
sources.document_page: Customer concentration; Note 2 Basis of Presentation; liquidity (curated summary, not a verbatim extract)
sources.document_version: Spirit FY2024 Form 10-K — concentration and liquidity
sources.text: Curated summary: Boeing and Airbus generated approximately 58% and 21% of Spirit consolidated FY2024 net revenue, respectively. These are Spirit customer revenue shares, not Boeing or Airbus procurement shares. Spirit disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. Debt at December 31, 2024 was USD 4,394.2 million, including 424.5 million short-term. The Boeing merger announced June 30, 2024 remained pending at this historical cutoff. The Boeing IAM strike was resolved November 4, 2024.

sources.title: Spirit FY2024 results — financial statements
sources.document_page: Consolidated statements of operations, balance sheets, cash flows; Q4 developments (unaudited earnings release, curated numerical transcription)
sources.text: FY2024, consolidated USD millions: revenue 6316.6; net loss including noncontrolling interests -2139.0; operating cash flow -1120.9. At December 31, 2024: cash and cash equivalents 537.0; current assets 3760.5; current liabilities 3567.4; total equity including noncontrolling interests -2616.0. Common-shareholder net loss was -2139.8 and stockholders equity excluding noncontrolling interests was -2621.5; these alternative bases are not used in the ratios. Q4 funding: Boeing agreed advances up to 350 and Airbus a credit line up to 107; 200 and 70 respectively had been advanced at year end. These are liquidity support, not revenue or compensation for a quantified strike loss.

sources.title: Spirit Q3 2024 results — Boeing strike response
sources.document_page: Page 1, Impact of Boeing IAM Strike (curated summary)
sources.document_version: Spirit Q3 2024 results — Boeing strike response
sources.text: In response to the Boeing IAM strike that began September 13, 2024, Spirit announced a 21-day furlough for approximately 700 employees on the 767 and 777 programs, citing inventory buildup. It also announced a hiring freeze and travel and overtime restrictions. This is a documented announcement of operational measures, not a measured revenue loss.

sources.title: Boeing FY2024 results
sources.document_page: Full-year GAAP results and cash flows (curated numerical transcription)
sources.text: FY2024 consolidated USD millions: net loss -11829; operating cash flow -12080. Boeing reported impacts of the IAM work stoppage and agreement. These company-wide losses are not attributed solely to the strike or to Spirit.

sources.title: Airbus FY2024 results
sources.text: FY2024 consolidated EUR millions: revenue 69230; net income attributable to equity owners 4232; free cash flow 4461. Positive earnings alone do not establish low risk. EUR figures are not added to USD figures.
